title: Technology Sector Update for 05/17/2018: INTC,TTWO

Technology stocks were edging higher Thursday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.1% while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting a more than 0.2% gain.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Intel Corp. ( INTC ) was higher Thursday afternoon, climbing as much as 1.5%, after the hardware company's Mobileye (MBLY) unit has received a contract from an unnamed European automaker to provide 8 million vehicles with advanced driver assistance systems. The deal starts in 2021, with the Mobileye system available on selected models and certain models being fitted with a more advanced system of conditional automation, according to Reuters, citing an unidentified company official. Financial terms and other details of the contract were not disclosed.
In other sector news:
+ Take-Two Interactive Software ( TTWO ) was rising Thursday after analysts at Benchmark Capital raised their price target for the electronic games publisher by $5 to $135 a share and reiterated their Buy rating for the company's stock. On Wednesday,Take-Two reported Q4 net income of $0.77 per share, missing the Capital IQ consensus by $0.19 per share. Revenue for the January-to-March quarter fell to $450.3 million from $571.5 million last year but topped the $444.6 million Street view.
